name: 動きベクトル解析
description: Analyzes motion vector consistency and smoothness
algorithm: Motion Vector Analysis — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes motion vectors from video compression for forensic detection:

1. **動きベクトル抽出**: Block-level motion vectors are extracted from the video bitstream (H.264/H.265 encoded streams contain explicitly coded motion vectors). These describe how the encoder predicted each block from reference frames.

2. **動きFieldコヒーレンス**: The motion vector field should be physically coherent — nearby blocks should have similar motion vectors (smoothly varying field) except at object boundaries. The method detects regions with anomalous motion vector patterns inconsistent with physical object motion or camera motion.

3. **Foreground-Background動きSeparation**: Global camera motion produces a coherent motion vector field across the frame, while object motion creates local deviations. The method separates these components and verifies that face/body motion is physically consistent. Deepfake insertion may produce face motion that's inconsistent with the camera motion model.

4. **動きベクトル大きさ分布**: The distribution of motion vector magnitudes follows predictable patterns depending on motion speed and search range. The method analyzes this distribution for anomalies — re-encoded deepfakes may show motion vector distributions affected by the original encoding, creating detectable double-estimation artifacts.

5. **PredictionError相関**: Motion vectors should produce effective predictions (low residual). The method analyzes the correlation between motion vector quality and prediction residuals. Regions where motion vectors are optimal for the original content but suboptimal for inserted content reveal manipulation through elevated prediction errors.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through motion vector analysis analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
